prerequisites: Students must have a maximum of 132 study points remaining to obtain the diploma at the start of the academic year.
Students have previous experience with group work and project work at a higher education level.

learning_outcomes.text: Students can solve interdisciplinary and integrated technical problems and case studies in a methodical way.
Students can translate a realistic problem into a mathematical model.
Students can break down a problem into sub-problems.
Students can use their mathematical background to solve the various sub-problems.
Students can interpret the result of calculations.
Report orally to both a scientific audience and a wider audience.
Develop the attitudes of conscientiousness, a critical attitude, independence, and a sense of responsibility.

syllabus_topics: Design and execution of an engineering project
Use of generative AI for scientific reporting

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of the entire project

assessment_rules: The final grade is based on a process evaluation (20%), a final report (40%), an oral presentation (20%), and a demonstration of the final product (20%). A correction of max. +/- 10% can be applied through peer assessment, and a penalty of up to 20% is possible for not adhering to deadlines and agreements. If a student fails the 'Process' component, they cannot pass the course, with a maximum overall score of 9/20. If the evaluation shows that one or more learning outcomes have been insufficiently achieved, the overall result may deviate from the weighted average.
